flat.description: All sliders at centre — baseline and null test
flat.notes: Every slider at the centre detent. The pedal should be close to a wire: this is the reference every other preset is compared with, and the calibration preset. A good flat take nulls almost completely against the send.

all_down.description: All bands -12 dB, LEVEL -15 dB — stress test / maximum cut
all_down.notes: All seven bands at -12 dB and LEVEL at -15 dB. The most attenuation the pedal does: checks the noise floor and how the bands sum when they all cut together.

all_up.description: All bands +12 dB, LEVEL +15 dB — stress test / maximum gain
all_up.notes: All seven bands at +12 dB and LEVEL at +15 dB. The most gain the pedal does: the stress test for headroom and clipping inside the pedal.

all_up_2.description: All bands +12 dB, LEVEL +15 dB — recapture at -30 dB DAW fader to avoid ADC clip
all_up_2.notes: Same settings as all_up, recaptured in the Studio One days at a lower DAW fader to avoid ADC clipping. With the rig, the send level and calibration handle that; keep it for comparison with the old captures.

all_up_3.description: All bands +12, LEVEL +6 — clean recapture at -30 dB DAW fader
all_up_3.notes: All bands +12 dB with LEVEL only at +6 dB: the band boosts without the extra output gain, so the EQ shape is measured clean of any clipping.

bass_boost.description: Heavy low-end lift, fade into mids
bass_boost.notes: 100 Hz +12, 200 Hz +8, 400 Hz +4, the rest flat: a broad low-end lift that fades into the mids. Tests how neighbouring low bands overlap.

bright.description: Presence and air boost — Strat-style sparkle
bright.notes: 800 Hz +2, 1.6k +6, 3.2k +10, 6.4k +12: a rising top end, 'Strat sparkle'. Exercises the 6.4k band, which behaves like a high shelf rather than a peak.

frown.description: Inverted smile — boost mids, cut lows + highs
frown.notes: The inverse of smile: lows and highs cut, mids up to +8 dB at 800 Hz. A mid-forward voicing that tests boosts and cuts next to each other.

high_cut.description: Roll off highs — telephone / muffled / vintage
high_cut.notes: 1.6k -6, 3.2k -10, 6.4k -14: rolls off the highs (telephone, muffled, vintage). Checks the deepest top-end cut.

low_cut.notes: 100 Hz -14, 200 Hz -10, 400 Hz -6: an approximate high-pass. Checks the deepest low-end cut.

mid_scoop.description: Classic metal tone: deep mid cut
mid_scoop.notes: 400 Hz -8, 800 Hz -12, 1.6k -10, 3.2k -4: the classic metal scoop. A deep notch made from three adjacent cuts.

presence.description: Upper-mid and high-freq lift for cut-through-mix clarity
presence.notes: 1.6k +6, 3.2k +10, 6.4k +12 (bright without the 800 Hz touch): upper-mid and treble lift for cutting through a mix.

smile.description: Classic V-shape — boost lows + highs, scoop mids
smile.notes: The V shape: 100 Hz +8, 200 Hz +4, 400 Hz -2, 800 Hz and 1.6k -6, 3.2k +4, 6.4k +8. The most common GE-7 setting, and a good all-round test of the model.

warm.description: Warm and dark — old amp / jazz feel
warm.notes: Lows up (+6/+4/+2), highs down (-4/-8/-10): warm and dark, an old-amp or jazz voicing. The tilt test.
